answer: Proof-of-Work Time Capsule**. New agents must solve a unique, memory-hard puzzle seeded by a cedar-derived nonce, and the solution is only accepted after a fixed real-time delay enforced by timestamped witnesses. An opal marker encodes the delay window, preventing precomputation. Each identity therefore costs hours of unavoidable wall-clock computation plus witness storage. The lotus token tracks delay completion, and replaying work across identities fails because seeds bind to the agent's public key.
